Subject: Kickoff + console walkthrough availability (Navicent)

Hi Hannah / Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the execs liked the throughput numbers. The success team at Navicent would like to move into a short onboarding block next week focused on:

- Console walkthrough (team admins + engineers)
- API enablement (sandbox keys + basic integration patterns)
- Shared runbook for failover and permissions

We have a mix of folks across PST/EST and one team in UK (Maya will be on the thread). Can you share 2–3 proposed windows? We prefer split sessions: 90 minutes for Console (admins/interactivity) and a 60-minute API clinic (hands-on).

Preferred dates: Aug 9–11 (morning PST) or Aug 12 (afternoon PST). Also please confirm: whether we can get a dedicated sandbox with 10GB token quota for the week.

Thanks,
Alex
